name: ZimaBrain-CE
description: Local, verifier-first diagnostic assistant for MOS

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Reports, trend history, your login password (as a hash) and the session key. Both are made on first start.

paths.name: Docs
paths.description: Read-only. Put extra manuals or notes in the docs folder of the app folder and ZimaBrain CE uses them in its answers.

paths.name: Proc
paths.description: Read-only view of the host's processes, for diagnostics

paths.name: Sys
paths.description: Read-only view of the host's hardware and disks, for diagnostics

paths.name: Hostname
paths.description: Read-only host name of your MOS box

paths.name: Docker.Sock
paths.description: Read-only access to Docker, to check your containers and their mounts

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: ZimaBrain CE web UI, published on host as 6162

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
